text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'd like to give you 
something in return...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told Dream Journey that no thanks were 
necessary, and that I was just glad to 
have been of help.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Devoting one's heart entirely for the 
sake of others like this... is truly not 
something just anyone can do."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks to you, I believe I'll get to see 
my junior's smile."
choice_data_list:
You're the kind one here. You really care 
about your juniors.

You're the kind one here. You really care 
about your juniors, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I simply try my best every day to make 
sure all our committee members feel 
comfortable.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Because doing so will also help us work 
with greater enthusiasm.
